mentions.name: Eigakan Guide
mentions.description: This is a cinema showtime aggregator for Japan that lets users filter showtimes by area, cinema, date, time, and features such as IMAX, English audio, and English subtitles (e.g. IMAX showtimes with English audio on Friday after 7PM). It has added hundreds of cinemas and user features for saving search filters, movies, and specific showtimes. It also offers a ChatGPT plugin for natural-language showtime search inside ChatGPT and on-site AI search for queries like 'English audio showtimes near Shinjuku tomorrow'.
mentions.problem: Popular cinema sites in Japan only allow very few filters, making it hard to find exactly the showtimes you're looking for.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Eigakan Guide (https://eigakanguide.jp/en), a cinema showtime aggregator for Japan. Every popular cinema site in Japan only allows for very few filters, making it hard to find exactly what I was looking for.
mentions.author: m007850
